verdict.rationale: Epic's privacy policy explicitly covers Unreal Engine. It states that users may have the right to delete personal data, and it gives a general retention statement ('as long as we reasonably need it'). This is policy-level deletion rights only: there is no user-controllable retention setting or self-serve deletion tooling. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, self-serve or programmatic deletion controls, documented deletion timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You may have the right to access, correct, or delete personal data we have collected about you through the Epic Services.
We generally store personal information for as long as we reasonably need it for the purposes described in this policy
